variants.briefing:
ArcCorp needs your help.

Under Imperator Addison’s new Second Life initiative, they’ve introduced a government program that will reward whichever company gathers the most resources to help with the regen crisis. ArcCorp is eager to win, and to do that we need plenty of reliable and dependable contractors.

If you can knock out this easy hauling job and show you’re competent, then I can start offering you some more complicated work next.

For this job, you’ll need a ship that can take [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers and a multi-tool with a tractor beam attachment. Once you’re ready, head over to [Location], grab the cargo from the freight elevator, and deliver it to a freight elevator at: [Destination]. Easy, right?

If you want to keep track of how ArcCorp is stacking up against the competition, you can go to the Second Life Resource Drive section of your Journal. If you do really well and help us get to the top, I’ve been given permission by my superiors at ArcCorp to reward the hardest working contractors with some extra stuff on top of whatever credits you earn.

Come work for ArcCorp and be part of the winning team.

Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp

variants.displayName: RESOURCE DRIVE: GET OUR SMALL CARGO BACK
variants.briefing:
Hi, it’s El.

Looking for a decent enough contractor who isn’t afraid to take on some outlaws and recover the cargo they stole.

Since my boss is breathing down my neck about the numbers we’re pulling for this Second Life thing, we’re organizing multiple teams to hit all of the gang’s stash houses. You’re being assigned to go to [Location], deal with whatever’s going on over there, and bring the [ItemsToRecover] cargo boxes (all [MaxBoxSize] SCU or smaller) stashed there back.

When you’ve got the stuff, take it to a freight elevator at: [Destination]. Our staff will get it logged for you.

If you can do your part and get as many boxes back as possible, we’ll make sure you’re given credit for everything the whole team brings back.

Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp

variants.displayName: RESOURCE DRIVE: LARGE CARGO SHIP NEEDS HELP
variants.briefing:
Outlaws have hit an ArcCorp transport ship over at [Location] and they need urgent help defending it.

The cargo aboard is of vital importance to our standing in the Second Life resource drive, and we can’t afford to lose it. The captain and crew said they’re doing their best to hang on and get their quantum drive repaired, but honestly, I don’t think they have a chance at escaping unless they get some help. If they do make it back in one piece, I’ll make sure you get shared credit for the delivery.

Don’t underestimate these outlaws. Bring as much firepower as you got and some backup if you can.

Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp

variants.displayName: RESOURCE DRIVE: MEDIUM CARGO NEEDS HAULING
variants.briefing:
Hey it’s El.

Need a quick turnaround on this so I’ll get right to it.

One of our haulers miscalculated how much storage they had and has left a bunch of cargo over at [Location]. We need someone with a ship that can handle [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers to pick them up from the freight elevator for us.

Don’t come unprepared like the last contractor. You’ll need a heavy-duty tractor beam and probably another crew member if you want to avoid spending all day moving boxes.

Grab the cargo and take it to a freight elevator at: [Destination].

Go team.

Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp

variants.briefing:
El here.

Bit worried about one of our contractors who’s been ghosting me and hasn’t completed their delivery of resources for the UEE initiative.

I need someone to head out to [Location] where they were last seen and bring back that cargo for us.

It was only between 50-55 SCU of various box sizes, so it shouldn’t be too hard for you to move them if you have a tractor beam, but that doesn’t mean you should take this job lightly. I’m a little worried there’s a reason our pilot isn’t responding. Be sure to keep an eye out for any hostiles in the area.

Get the cargo to a freight elevator at: [Destination]. I’ll ensure it gets to the right place.

Actually, if you have another pilot with you, you might find it simpler to have one of you fly the cargo ship instead. Your call though.

Thanks for the assist,

Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp

variants.briefing:
Sending out an urgent request to any available contractor with combat pilot experience.

A small transport ship of ours is currently being attacked by a group of outlaws at [Location].

There’s a huge push for each delivery to help us to win this Second Life initiative, so we need someone to get over there, sort those outlaws out, and allow our transporter time to escape.

Needless to say, we’ll pay you if our hauler manages to deliver the goods and you’ll get credited for the SCU.

Gotta go,

Ella Tieno
Contractor Liaison Officer
ArcCorp
